items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: I did quite a few of those Jackie Gleason recording dates.

ctx.x: And we talked about that. Did you do anything else for CBS besides the Godfrey show? Around, that time?
No. That was it. Of course while I was on the Godfrey show, I did quite a few of those Jackie Gleason recording dates.
